step_2_method_label_verification.2a_assignment_mechanism: build_split_full59.py scans data/waveforms/CelebDF/TalkingFace/{method}/*.npy where 'method' is the directory name. Labels are derived from directory names, not from a global positional ordering.
step_2_method_label_verification.2a_structure: SEVEN INDEPENDENT per-method decisions — each method has its own dedicated subdirectory; the label is the directory name.
step_2_method_label_verification.2a_evidential_implication: A correct fingerprint match for one generator confirms that directory's identity. A misnamed source directory would mislabel all waveforms in it.

group_25fps_512x512.note: both level=30, Lavf58.76.100, no stream encoder — indistinguishable by extended metadata

group_25fps_256x256.note: AniTalker by stream encoder; EDTalk by level=20; IP_LAP vs SadTalker by format encoder Lavf58.76.100 vs Lavf60.16.100

2d_cardinality_disambiguation.FLOAT_vs_Real3DPortrait: Both share same encoder fingerprint. Total waveform cardinalities: FLOAT=2950, Real3DPortrait=2744. These differ, so cardinality could in principle distinguish them — but labels already come from directory names, not counts.
2d_cardinality_disambiguation.note: Cardinality disambiguation is circular given directory-derived labels.

2e_determination.residual_swap_note: FLOAT and Real3DPortrait share identical (fps=25, resolution=512x512, codec=h264, level=30, Lavf58.76.100, no stream encoder). They cannot be separated by any measured metadata. Their total cardinalities differ (2950 vs 2744) but that does not break the ambiguity without an external ground-truth anchor.

step_3_no_stretched_reeval.3a_identification_method: too_short entries in data/waveforms/CelebDF_30fps/extraction_log.csv; all 2225 have matching native waveforms confirming they were linspace-stretched in native run
step_3_no_stretched_reeval.3a_real_videos_stretched_note: Real videos use stride-60 sliding windows. The linspace path activates on partial last windows (< 160 frames). This applies to both classes but is particularly relevant for fakes because ALL waveforms from short fake videos are stretched (the entire fake is a single stretched window), whereas for reals only the final partial window of a multi-window video is stretched.
